g.text: A linkedin.com/pulse/ URL that is its own canonical, with no field to point it at your blog
Robots meta max-image-preview:large, noarchive, and no noindex
Body links usually rewritten to linkedin.com/redir/redirect, which robots.txt disallows for Googlebot
